subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

RBS : OXN :: OXA : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given cluster is:

 
• **First alphabet is decreased to 3 positional values.**
 
• Second alphabet is decreased to 4 positional values.
 
• Third alphabet is decreased to 5 positional values.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f84adedfaa9a663f7652ab3825c7d7d0b1d605809ea4481e1e6347c84088d9.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3084d709680ca04e8d4a6c5bcdbca23bc68644cc17650476e362cb016b98ba59.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**
